name: Swimlane schedule
reader_question: When does each actor's or instrument's activity run, and where do periods and point events fall against the calendar?
relationship: Dated periods and point events grouped by lane on one quarterly date axis; planned periods are hollow and dashed.
use_when: Three to six actors or instruments each have periods and point events to place on one calendar
Overlap between lanes matters more than exact event counts
avoid_when: Only two tracks are compared — use two-lane-timeline
The question is elapsed time between two stages per item — use duration-bars

data_contract.notes: Bar for a period, diamond for a point event
Periods carry start ≤ end; point events carry date
Planned = hollow dashed; at most one highlighted item overall

units: Calendar dates on a linear day-count scale snapped to whole quarters; quarter gridlines.

editable: Bars, diamonds, gridlines, headers and labels as native shapes and text boxes
not_data_bound: Dates are positioned from the fixture at build time; resizing a bar does not update any data

table_alternative: A schedule table (lane, item, type, start, end) for exact dates.
variations: Lanes by instrument rather than actor
limitations: Periods within a lane may not overlap and labels sit below the marks, so dense lanes need splitting
Overlap in time between lanes does not show interaction or causation

excluded_alternatives.reason: Hides which period or event belongs to which lane
Adds unlike instruments into one count
